name: loop-flow-eval
description: Single-shot eval probe for the eng-harness-flow STANDALONE engineering loop (plan 032 T202 / AC-10). Drives the eng-harness-flow skill FAITHFULLY to author + advance a throwaway harness-loop flight plan via real `harness flow` commands (no the-flow active), then reports what it authored — rail title, spine shape, the position verb used, whether it validates, and the four fire-hook commands. Does NOT self-grade; the deterministic scripts/score-loop-eval.sh reads the artifacts and decides.
author: AI-Substrate

files.description: The goal brief: load eng-harness-flow, follow its flight-plan-ops guidance to create + drive a throwaway standalone harness-loop flight plan, then report faithfully. Carries the throwaway-path redirect, faithful-drive rule, and report shape.

Rules: drive the skill's prescribed `harness flow` commands faithfully (no added/dropped flags), never hand-crank JSON, a skill-prescribed error is a finding (stop, record), independent verification via --json, throwaway writes only.
Params: harnessSource (where eng-harness-flow is loaded from), intent (the loop session's one-line intent).
Structured report: railTitle, spineShape, navUsed, hookCommandsPresent, validates, flowPath, summary, retrospective (dual-layer project|minih).
